name: haxe-sockets
description: Client TCP and TLS sockets for Haxe sys targets. OpenFL/AIR-inspired API using callbacks and haxe.io.Bytes (not a full OpenFL port). Mutual TLS and CA pinning helpers included. No haxelib dependencies.
releasenote: Pre-release client preview: Socket and SecureSocket only. No ServerSocket or DatagramSocket. Docs state production TLS limits honestly.
